name: Falken's Maze
summary: A maze hidden in fog: you see only the cells you stood on, and where their passages lead. Every six moves WOPR moves a wall still in the fog, to make your way out longer.
howToPlay: Walk the @ from START at the top left to the [] EXIT at the bottom right. The maze is 19 cells wide and 5 cells high.
Each key press moves one cell. A wall stops you. A move into a wall does not count as a move.
Cells not yet seen show as a dim dot. Walls you saw never change. You can always reach the exit.
Every 6 moves WOPR moves a wall not yet seen, at most 12 times a game. The bottom of the frame counts your MOVES, YOUR TURNS at junctions (LEFT, STRAIGHT, RIGHT) and WALLS MOVED.
Press Q to give up. WOPR tells you how many moves away the exit was.

controls.does: move one cell up, down, left or right
move up, left, down or right (either case)
move left, down, up or right (lower case only)
give up. WOPR says how far away the exit was
leave the game and return to WOPR

tips: Keep one hand on the wall: always take the left-most way (or always the right-most). The maze never has loops, even after WOPR moves a wall. So if you follow one wall, you always get out.
Walls move only where you did not look yet. Every cell you saw keeps its walls. So a dead end you found stays a dead end. You need to search only the fog.
WOPR moves at most 12 walls, one every 6 moves. After 72 moves the maze stops changing. So a slow, careful search still finds the exit.
WOPR closes passages where the way on is your favourite turn at a junction. Vary your left and right turns.

screenshots.caption: The start: everything is fog except your first cell. The @ stands at START and the [] marks the EXIT at the bottom right.
Move 50: WOPR moved 8 walls so far, and says YOU FAVOUR RIGHT TURNS, PROFESSOR. SO NOTED.
Out: ESCAPED, drawn in the maze's own walls, then YOU FOUND THE EXIT IN 52 MOVES. WOPR MOVED 8 WALLS.
